sections.heading:
world-class music for weddings and events.
Let's elevate your event into an unforgettable musical experience.
columns:
Over the years, we’ve had the honor of bringing joy to diverse audiences from all walks of life. Driven by our passion for creating a musical experience that connects everyone, we’ve crafted a rich repertoire spanning a wide range of styles — ensuring every event, no matter its theme, is vibrant and memorable.

We collaborate with leading production companies and organizations, performing at top venues both in Israel and abroad. Our performances bring an electrifying energy to the dance floor, delivering excitement and emotion while maintaining the highest standards of sound quality and state-of-the-art equipment.

We take pride in offering each client personal and professional attention, ensuring we not only meet your preferences and expectations — but exceed them.

Looking for Chassidic music? Israeli hits? Hosting international guests? Need a DJ for the after-party or a violin ensemble to add emotion to your ceremony?

With Kolot, your perfect event is just a beat away!

Hi there! If you’re here, congratulations are in order!
We get it — you want your event to be perfect, with every detail just right.
You’ve chosen the ideal venue, the stunning décor, and made sure the food is nothing short of amazing. Now you’ve arrived at the most crucial element — the music.

You might be wondering:
How can you tie it all together with the perfect atmosphere and music that will make your event truly unforgettable?

Allow us to introduce ourselves — we are Kolot.
With 15 years of experience, over 1,000 unforgettable weddings and events, and collaborations with Israel’s top artists and musicians, Kolot is your go-to for exceptional music, vibrant energy, and joy that knows no limits.
